description: This Java class 'MappingStrategiesBuilder' is a mutable builder with a fluent API used to construct and manage a Map containing JSON deserialization strategies for different classes and types. It primarily facilitates registration and retrieval of strategies for converting JSON objects into specific 'JsonParsable' objects, supporting the addition of strategies via class types, class names, and external registries. The class includes predefined strategies for known types and provides methods for extending the mapping with custom strategies.

classes.name: MappingStrategiesBuilder
classes.description: A mutable builder class for constructing a map of JSON deserialization strategies, facilitating registration of handlers for various types and classes, and supporting predefined strategies for known types.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the builder with predefined strategies for common types.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Overloaded methods to add JSON deserialization strategies to the builder, supporting class types, class names, and external registries.

methods.name: putAll
methods.description: Adds multiple mapping strategies from an existing map to the builder.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Returns a finalized, immutable Map containing all registered strategies.
